profile: Keyless Python rules with explicit-DPI Polish Tesseract.
scope: All 30 organizer scans are development data. Private evaluations cover corpus 1 all, its nested dev subset and corpus 2 dev. Corpus 2 test was excluded.
staged_measurement: Per-step development comparisons replay identical first-pass OCR text and real word boxes, and rerun targeted crops from the PDFs. Bounded parallel OCR was exercised uncached on all 30 organizer PDFs and on affected multi-scan private PDFs; single-page or native private inputs reuse the same first pass. Integrated and final uncached organizer outputs matched field-for-field.
scoring: evals.metrics.summarise with zero-byte outputs for negatives; exact counts compare every JSON field literally, including case, punctuation, Unicode and null. Absent output fields count as errors even for a null reference.

timing.method: One process, serial PDFs, Apple M1 CPU, OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1, all 30 scans read uncached from PDF. Time includes decoding, recognition, field extraction and JSON serialization. The four stage timers exclude nested work so their sum equals wall time. Within concurrent batches the first-OCR wall envelope includes overlapping e-mail verification. On serial pages it is timed separately under rereads/crops. Targeted rereads count invocations of account/title crop helpers and, on the integrated run, the grant register verification helper including its eligibility check. Process startup and class configuration are outside per-PDF times. The host was shared with other workers and absolute times varied between runs.
